scope: Current Products Devnet application stack and ChopDot-relevant open-source donors. See RESEARCH-002_PARITY_PRODUCTS_DEVNET_CAPABILITY_CATALOG.md for details.

entries.name: Asset Hub
entries.chopdotUse: Native PAS/DOT and verified asset settlement; minimal justified public contract state.

entries.name: People / Individuality
entries.chopdotUse: Optional identity context, anti-spam or human-friendly lookup later.

entries.name: Bulletin Chain
entries.chopdotUse: Encrypted receipts, exports, app bundles and proof packages.

entries.name: Statement Store
entries.chopdotUse: Optional DB-version invalidation and narrowly scoped coordination.

entries.name: Product SDK
entries.chopdotUse: Canonical new SDK family for ChopDot adapters after package-family verification.

entries.name: Product SDK chain-client
entries.chopdotUse: Canonical chain connection seam

entries.name: Product SDK tx
entries.chopdotUse: Native/asset transaction execution and evidence

entries.name: Product SDK signer
entries.chopdotUse: Authenticated product-account signing

entries.name: Product SDK contracts
entries.chopdotUse: Runtime contract calls if a justified contract feature exists

entries.name: Product SDK cloud-storage
entries.chopdotUse: Encrypted artifact storage only

entries.name: Product SDK statement-store
entries.chopdotUse: Optional coordination/wakeup

entries.name: Product SDK individuality
entries.chopdotUse: Optional identity/personhood context

entries.name: Product SDK keys
entries.chopdotUse: Host/SDK internals; never store user master keys

entries.name: Product SDK local-storage
entries.chopdotUse: Local drafts/cache with explicit migrations

entries.name: Product SDK host
entries.chopdotUse: Capability detection and graceful fallback

entries.name: Product SDK address
entries.chopdotUse: Replace ad hoc address code

entries.name: Product SDK crypto
entries.chopdotUse: Only reviewed encryption envelopes and key lifecycle

entries.name: Product SDK descriptors
entries.chopdotUse: Pin with runtime/chain client

entries.name: Product SDK logger + utils
entries.chopdotUse: Redacted observability and display helpers

entries.name: TrUAPI
entries.chopdotUse: Use through Product SDK; raw protocol only for explicit compatibility work.

entries.name: Triangle JS SDKs
entries.chopdotUse: Keep inherited compatibility paths only; migrate toward Product SDK + TrUAPI.

entries.name: Polkadot Web / dotli
entries.chopdotUse: Primary web-host target and real sandbox/capability test surface.

entries.name: Polkadot Desktop
entries.chopdotUse: Required verification target; widgets/background mode later.

entries.name: Polkadot Android
entries.chopdotUse: Payer/recipient mobile host, deeplinks and signing-return UX.

entries.name: Polkadot iOS
entries.chopdotUse: Payer/recipient mobile host, safe-area and rejection testing.

entries.name: Host API Test SDK
entries.chopdotUse: Deterministic host E2E and rejection/failure tests.

entries.name: DotNS protocol
entries.chopdotUse: Product identifier and optional verified receive/contact records.

entries.name: DotNS SDK/CLI
entries.chopdotUse: Use instead of hand-rolled name logic after release/network match.

entries.name: Polkadot App Deploy / pad
entries.chopdotUse: Reproducible ChopDot release deployment with commit/CID/domain evidence.

entries.name: Browse
entries.chopdotUse: Publish after release gate; use source for live ecosystem catalog refresh.

entries.name: Browse SDK
entries.chopdotUse: Automated live catalog refresh and optional future discovery surface.

entries.name: Contract Dependency Manager
entries.chopdotUse: Only if ChopDot adopts a justified contract feature.

entries.name: Contexts / Reputation / Disputes
entries.chopdotUse: Future donor for formal disputes, not a v1 requirement.

entries.name: Polkadot Attestation Protocol
entries.chopdotUse: Potential app certification or signed group-close proof later.

entries.name: Polkadot App Identity Backend
entries.chopdotUse: Architecture donor confirming Postgres/service pattern.

entries.name: Playground CLI
entries.chopdotUse: Development/deployment donor and network-support reality check.

entries.name: Playground Template
entries.chopdotUse: Smallest integration donor for ChopDot adapter tests.

entries.name: Playground App Registry
entries.chopdotUse: Deployment provenance and donor discovery.

entries.name: Playground Tutorial
entries.chopdotUse: Validates progressive adoption of Polkadot primitives.

entries.name: Simple Survey
entries.chopdotUse: Artifact/index separation donor.

entries.name: Rock Paper Scissors
entries.chopdotUse: Coordination/evidence donor, not ledger pattern.

entries.name: Feedback Board
entries.chopdotUse: Shows content/index split and why ChopDot personal data should not be public.

entries.name: Mercado
entries.chopdotUse: Donor for settlement/dispute lifecycle only.

entries.chopdotUse: Strong donor for host-native multi-rail coordination and evidence.

entries.name: Polkadot Apps package family
entries.chopdotUse: Migration context only.

entries.name: Polkadot Hub App
entries.chopdotUse: Donor for module isolation and shared data architecture.

entries.chopdotUse: Align host-native feel while keeping ChopDot consumer identity.
